questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks Dr. Sofia: 'How to adapt my practice to my age?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Keep the same pace as at 30
Invest in ergonomic tools and an adapted chair
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, invest in an ergonomic chair, loupes with LED lighting, and light instruments. Your body will thank you.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders: 'How to maintain my concentration at the end of the day?' Dr. Sofia suggests he:
options: Work longer to get used to it
Reduce the number of patients at the end of the day and plan breaks
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, arrange your schedule. Reduce complex patients in the afternoon and plan a 15-minute break to recharge your batteries.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'My hands sometimes tremble.' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Consult a neurologist and adapt his gestures
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, tremors can have several causes. Consult a neurologist for a diagnosis, and adapt your gestures with lighter instruments.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to prevent back pain?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Practice muscle strengthening exercises and consult a physiotherapist
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, muscle strengthening and physiotherapy are essential. One physio session per week can change your professional life.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders: 'How to manage eye fatigue?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Use loupes with adapted lighting and take visual breaks
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, loupes with good lighting and regular visual breaks (20-20-20 rule) will protect your eyes.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to evaluate if I am still competent?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Compare his speed with the young
Do a self-assessment and ask for feedback from colleagues
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, self-assessment and feedback from colleagues are the best indicators. Competence is not only measured by speed, but also by precision and clinical wisdom.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I don't know when to stop.' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Set a retirement date and prepare gradually
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, set a retirement date, even a distant one. Prepare it gradually. A successful retirement is an anticipated one.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to train a successor?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Plan a transition over 1 to 2 years
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, a transition of 1 to 2 years allows not only the transfer of techniques, but also the patient relationship and the practice's values.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders: 'How to maintain my professional network?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Cut himself off from the world
Participate in congresses and colleagues' meetings
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, the professional network is essential, especially at the end of a career. Participate in congresses, colleagues' meetings, stay visible.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to talk about my retirement to my patients?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Inform them gradually and introduce the successor
Tell them at the last moment
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, inform your patients gradually. Introduce them to your successor. The trust they have in you will be transferred to your successor if the transition is done well.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I don't know what to do with my life after retirement.' Dr. Sofia suggests he:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, retirement is a new life. Prepare projects: travel, hobbies, volunteering, teaching. A successful retirement is an active retirement.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage the legal aspects of transmission?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Consult a notary and a specialized lawyer
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, a notary and a specialized lawyer will accompany you in the legal aspects of transmission. Do not neglect this step.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders: 'How to evaluate the value of my practice?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Have it evaluated by an accountant
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, a professional evaluation by an accountant is essential for a successful transfer. It will save you from unpleasant surprises.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to choose my successor?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Choose a colleague who shares his values
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, choose a colleague who shares your values and your vision of care. Transmission is not just about equipment, it's about values.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I fear losing my patients.' Dr. Sofia replies:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, a well-prepared transmission minimizes losses. Introduce your successor, ensure continuity, and patient trust will be maintained.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to train my successor in patient relations?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Let him observe and learn on the job
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, co-consultation sessions are ideal. The successor sees you interact with patients, learns your relational techniques, and gains their trust.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders about the future of his assistant. Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Introduce her to the successor and discuss her future
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, your assistant is an essential part of the practice. Introduce her to the successor and discuss her future. A stable team reassures patients.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage the decrease in income at the end of a career?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Plan his finances over several years
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, financial planning is essential. Anticipate the decrease in income, save, and plan an adapted lifestyle.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I feel isolated.' Dr. Sofia suggests he:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, isolation is a risk at the end of a career. Join groups of senior dentists, share your experience, stay connected.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to maintain my scientific credibility?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Follow training and developments in the profession
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, continuing education is essential. Follow developments, read scientific journals, participate in training.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed wonders: 'How to transmit my files?' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Transmit them to the successor with key information
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, the files must be transmitted to the successor with key information. A well-done file transmission ensures continuity of care.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to manage the stress of transmission?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
options: Surround himself with professionals and loved ones
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, transmission is a stressful step. Surround yourself with professionals (notary, accountant) and your loved ones. You are not alone.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed confides: 'I don't want to be a burden to my children.' Dr. Sofia replies:
options: Preparing your succession is the best gift for your children
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, preparing your succession is the best gift you can give your children. They won't have to manage a complicated succession.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed asks: 'How to keep the passion for my profession?' Dr. Sofia advises him to:
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, passion is cultivated. Set yourself new challenges: teaching, mentoring, new techniques. Passion does not fade, it renews itself.'

questions.question: Dr. Ahmed, after becoming aware of the importance of aging management, says to Dr. Sofia: 'I am ready to transmit.' Sofia replies: 'Transmitting is...'
options: Transmitting his knowledge, values, and humanity
questions.explanation: Sofia: 'Ahmed, transmitting is transmitting your knowledge, your values, and your humanity. It is the most beautiful legacy a dentist can leave.' Ahmed: 'Thank you, Sofia. I am ready.'
